canDoYue: 你識同同事講週末同天氣，再轉去開會。
canDoEn: Talk about the weekend and the weather, then start the meeting.

dialogue.speaker: ada
dialogue.text: Good morning Tom. How was your weekend, and was the weather nice and mild on Saturday?
dialogue.glossYue: 早晨 Tom。你週末點呀，星期六天氣係咪好？
dialogue.say: Good morning Tom. How was your weekend, and was the weather nice and mild on Saturday?

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Not bad at all. The weekend was busy with my sister in a cafe.
dialogue.glossYue: 幾好。週末好忙，我同家姐去咗咖啡店。
dialogue.say: Not bad at all. The weekend was busy with my sister in a cafe.

dialogue.speaker: ada
dialogue.text: Same here. My commute was long, but the coffee on the way was warm and good.
dialogue.glossYue: 我都係。通勤好長，但係路途嗰杯咖啡暖暖地好好飲。
dialogue.say: Same here. My commute was long, but the coffee on the way was warm and good.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: By the way, are you ready for the 10 o'clock meeting with the whole sales team?
dialogue.glossYue: 順便問下，十點同團隊嗰個會你準備好未？
dialogue.say: By the way, are you ready for the 10 o'clock meeting with the whole sales team?

dialogue.speaker: ada
dialogue.text: I am ready. Shall we go into the room before the team sits down?
dialogue.glossYue: 我準備好。我哋入房等團隊坐低？
dialogue.say: I am ready. Shall we go into the room before the team sits down?

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Yes, I think so. We can catch up later after the notes are on the table.
dialogue.glossYue: 好。筆記放喺檯之後，我哋遲啲再傾。
dialogue.say: Yes, I think so. We can catch up later after the notes are on the table.

dialogue.speaker: ada
dialogue.text: Then the team can quietly start once everyone has a quiet seat near the bright window.
dialogue.glossYue: 人人坐低近窗，團隊就可以開始。
dialogue.say: Then the team can quietly start once everyone has a quiet seat near the bright window.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Yes. I will open the door now, and we can begin the full meeting together inside.
dialogue.glossYue: 好。我而家開門，我哋入面一齊開始開會。
dialogue.say: Yes. I will open the door now, and we can begin the full meeting together inside.
